Why not ~/.config/bread_notes?

A website cannot choose or silently access folders on someone’s computer. That boundary protects personal files. Breadbook uses private browser storage and lets the user explicitly choose a JSON file when the browser supports it.

Erase the journal?

This removes all bakes and drafts saved in this browser. Download a backup first if you want to keep them.
